text.en:
Powered Melee Kills and Finishers apply weaken (increasing damage taken by 30%) and blind in a radius around the enemy.
Duration and Range are dependent on Enemy Rank. 

Bosses are not finishable. Guardians share the effects of Elites.

< table background_2 >
|b Enemy Rank        |b Minor |b Elite |b Miniboss |b Boss
|b Range             | 10    | 15    | 20       | 25
|b Duration          | 5     | 10    | 15       | 20
|b Finisher Duration | 10    | 15    | 20       | -
<$>
text.ko:
근접 공격 처치와 필살기 처치가 적을 실명시키고 30%의 추가 피해를 받게하는 폭발을 일으킵니다.
지속 시간과 폭발 반경은 적의 등급에 따라 결정됩니다.

적 등급은 부하/리더/미니보스/보스입니다.
필살기를 사용하면 지속 시간이 5초 추가됩니다. 수호자는 리더 취급입니다.

전쟁군주의 최후
폭발 범위: 폭심지로 부터 10/15/20/25 미터
지속 시간: 5/10/15/20 초
필살기를 사용했을 떄의 지속 시간: 10/15/20 초
text.zh-chs:
充能近战击杀和终结技会在敌人周围施加削弱效果（+30% 承受伤害）和致盲效果。
持续时间和范围取决于敌人的等级。

击杀敌方守护者视为精英的效果。首领无法被终结。

< table background_2 >
|b 敌人等级          |b 普通 |b 精英 |b 次级首领 |b 首领
|b 范围              | 10    | 15    | 20       | 25
|b 持续时间          | 5     | 10    | 15       | 20
|b 终结技持续时间     | 10    | 15    | 20       | -
<$>

Powered Melee and Finisher Kills disorient and debuff enemies in a given radius around the target, increasing damage received by them by 30%.

The debuff Duration and application radius are dependent on <link Enemy Rank [#CombatantClassifications] />:
• Minors: 10 meter radius, 5 second duration
• Elites, Players: 15m radius, 10s duration
• Minibosses: 20m radius, 15s duration
• Bosses: 25m radius, 20s duration

Finishers increase the debuff duration by 5 seconds. (Unconfirmed for Bosses)

Does not work with <strand/>Grapple melee or <solar/>Song of Flame.

Screen becomes fully blackened for 7.5 seconds upon getting hit by the debuff before gradually fading away over the next 7.5 seconds. (HUD remains unobstructed)

The debuff Duration and application radius are dependent on <link Enemy Rank [#CombatantClassifications] />:
• Minors: 15 meter radius, 10 second duration
• Elites, Players: 20m radius, 15s duration
• Minibosses, Bosses: 25m radius, 20s duration

Finishers increase the debuff duration by 5 seconds and the application radius by 5 meters. Both duration and radius are capped at the values provided by Bosses.

Applying <void/>Weaken to the target extends the debuff's duration.

Does not work with <strand/>Grapple melee or <solar/>Song of Flame melees.

Powered Melee damage <void/>Weakens targets for 6 seconds (15% debuff).

Powered Melee and Finisher Kills disorient and apply a stronger (30%) <void/>Weaken debuff to enemies in a given radius around the target.

The debuff Duration and application radius are dependent on <link Enemy Rank [#CombatantClassifications] />:
• Minors: 15 meter radius, 10 second duration
• Elites, Players: 20m radius, 15s duration
• Minibosses, Bosses: 25m radius, 20s duration

Finishers increase the debuff duration by 5 seconds and the application radius by 5 meters. Both duration and radius are capped at the values provided by killing (Mini)Bosses.

Additional PvP effects of on-kill debuffs: screen is blackened for 7.5 seconds before gradually fading away over the following 7.5 seconds. (HUD remains unobstructed)

Applying <void/>Weaken to the target extends the debuff's duration.
